component.name: BT-W Control
component.summary: Settings for Creative BT-W5 and BT-W6 Bluetooth audio dongles

description.p: Creative only makes its app for the BT-W5 and BT-W6 USB Bluetooth audio dongles for Windows and macOS. BT-W Control does the same on Linux.

ul.li: Switch aptX Adaptive between High Quality and Low Latency
Turn the headset microphone (HFP) on or off
Pair new headsets and switch between paired ones
Remember settings for each headset and apply them when it connects
Use Low Latency automatically while a game is running
Make the dongle the default audio device while a headset is connected
Get a notification when a headset connects or disconnects

description.p: It comes with a settings window, a system tray icon and a command line tool (btwctl).
Per-headset settings saved while that headset is connected are no longer overwritten by the next status check.
The window no longer flickers or ignores clicks while it checks the dongle's status.

Fixes for the background automation: changes made from the tray or command line are kept, game mode survives headset reconnects, sound follows the dongle after it restarts. No duplicate notifications. Man page and software centre listing.
Sound follows the headset; the window and tray can be translated; PPA and COPR packaging.
Renamed from btw5-switch to btwctl; Creative BT-W6 support.
First release: settings window, tray icon, per-headset settings, game mode and packages.
